scenes.title: The Problem of Consensus
scenes.script: In a distributed system, multiple independent computers must agree on a single source of truth, even when the network is unreliable.

scenes.title: The Raft Protocol
scenes.script: The Raft algorithm solves this by electing a single leader, who manages the replication of log entries across follower nodes.

scenes.title: Handling Partitions
scenes.script: When a network partition occurs, only the majority partition can make progress, ensuring safety and preventing split-brain states.
